text: Quick question—where should I upload the demo video for the new onboarding flow? Is that Branded or Unfiltered? I always mix these up.

Hey Jake! If it’s a polished demo that’s customer-facing or for marketing, it should go on the Branded channel. If it’s more of a casual walkthrough or just for internal/team/community folks, then Unfiltered is the way to go.

There’s a section in the handbook about this—think it’s under YouTube channels. Also, anything for Branded needs to go through digital production first for QC. If you’re not sure, you can ping the Digital Production team here on Slack.
Awesome, thanks Sara! This one’s pretty polished, so I’ll reach out to digital production before uploading to Branded.
